UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: User profile information and statistical counters.

uid.description: The unique user ID from Firebase Authentication.

photoURL.description: The URL of the user's avatar image.

totalReports.description: Total count of AI reports generated.

DatasetAnalysis.title: DatasetAnalysis
DatasetAnalysis.description: Information, metadata, samples, and AI insights generated for a dataset.

userId.description: The UID of the user who uploaded the dataset.

fileSize.description: Size of the file in bytes.

rowCount.description: Number of rows in the dataset.

columnCount.description: Number of columns in the dataset.

primaryKey.description: Guessed primary key column of the dataset.

dataQualityScore.description: Calculated score for data quality (0 to 100).

rawSample.description: A sample of raw data rows.

cleanedSample.description: A sample of cleaned data rows.

hasBeenCleaned.description: Whether the dataset has gone through the cleaning phase.

aiSummary.description: The structured AI insights summary object.

anomalies.description: List of anomalies identified in the data.

isFavorite.description: Whether this analysis has been marked as a favorite.

isShared.description: Whether this analysis is shared publicly.

users/{userId}.description: Collection storing registered user profile credentials and statistics.

analyses/{analysisId}.description: Collection storing the metadata, results, and generated insights for datasets.
